text:
The June 2025 finding is still accurate for what it covered, but it no longer describes the property's current status because it only looked at 2021–2024.

The current assessment (version 2, covering 2021–2025) finds a tree-cover loss candidate of 13.5 ha (3.9% of the asset) in 2025. It is in native forest context, and the JRC 2020 reference agrees on 98% of the event area. The status is pending corroboration because 2025 is the latest year in the series, so a later year is needed to confirm it persists.

This evidence does not establish:
- whether it was deforestation (Hansen loss includes any stand replacement, such as cutting a plantation)
- the cause
- whether it was legal
- any compliance finding

The earlier file should be updated and flagged as superseded. Re-check once 2026 data is available.
